name: RangeMonitor
description: Range monitor for a scalar measurement on ESP32, ESP8266 and AVR (Arduino). A median-of-3 spike filter and a time-based EMA smooth the value; soft limits raise an alarm only after a configurable delay, hard limits raise it at once, and invalid samples become a FAULT after their own delay. Reports every state transition, handles irregular sampling, allocates nothing dynamically, and runs on a host PC for testing and replaying recorded data.
keywords: monitor, alarm, threshold, hysteresis, ema, median, filter, temperature, sensor, freertos
